item.title: Rallying Cry – June 22, 2026
item.description: From a creative coconut trophy in Kerala to Messi breaking records, Iran’s heartfelt thank-you note in L.A., and Sydney capping road tolls, today’s good news is full of wins—plus a hacker turned solar energy champion and the best mushroom coffees to try in 2026!
